description: Owner-only: sign one 24-hour download link of a succeeded SQL ZIP export read by project_export_get, and audit it under the caller. The link is issued only with at least 24 hours of seven-day archive retention left; otherwise the request is refused with a conflict. Not idempotent: each call signs and audits another link, and an organization may take six links a minute, so after a 429 wait 60 seconds. download_url is a secret bearer capability. Keep the URL out of source, logs and persisted project notes, and request a fresh link when it expires. The password cannot be retrieved.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: project_export_download_link_create
